description: Craters, linked basins with little flat ground: the industry is packed onto the crater floors around the start, one Deep Ore Source lies in the central crater north-west of the start, and both Deep Ore Veins, the second source and the five Human Record Caches (around one Archive Excavation site) are on the high south-west plateau.

unmet.reason: On the saved water only 2 bank cells on the whole map border clean water at least 0.5 deep (the nearest at route 91 with 5 bridge cells); the clean river and crater lakes are shallower everywhere else.

The only dry, flat 20x15 footprints at any level (2, on the level-15 south-west plateau around x 20-39, y 9-23) are 77 cells from the nearest clean water, beyond the 15-cell coolant limit; nowhere else does a flat dry rectangle reach 20x15 (the largest square is 17x17, on that same plateau).

No 6x5 footprint touching the map edge is flat with a same-level door approach: the map border is sloped or wet everywhere except a 7x5 level-4 notch at x 93-99, y 187-191, whose door cells (y 186) stand one layer higher; the two flat edge spots at x 186-191, y 5-9 are under the source river.
